rules.applies_when: Linux startup is changed or diagnosed
acceptance: conclusion names exact failing stage and current artifacts
rules.failure_policy: preserve last bootable set and stop promotion

actions: cross-check reg IRQ clocks resets DMA regulators and pinctrl
acceptance: binding validation has no mandatory error
driver probe succeeds or target status remains NOT_RUN
rules.failure_policy: block target integration on resource conflict

actions: audit probe/remove and every error unwind
test open/close suspend/resume unload where supported
acceptance: each acquired resource is released exactly once on every path
no sleeping operation occurs in atomic context
concurrent access follows documented lock order
rules.failure_policy: reject driver integration; preserve oops/lockdep evidence

rules.applies_when: kernel/user ABI is introduced or changed
acceptance: stable ABI is not silently broken
rules.failure_policy: retain old ABI or require explicit migration

acceptance: service does not require unnecessary root/capabilities
repeated failure cannot create restart storm or unbounded logs
rules.failure_policy: disable service safely and retain diagnostics

rules.applies_when: Bootloader kernel DTB rootfs or applications are updated
actions: stage update without destroying last good set
acceptance: partial/mixed incompatible component set cannot boot as accepted
health failure restores last verified system
rules.failure_policy: remain/revert to last good slot and block release
